page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highcpu-4 is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the c4n server family. It features 4 vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8581C processor, operating at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, and has zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The underlying x86_64 architecture supports advanced instruction sets, including Intel Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX-512) and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX_TILE and AMX_INT8). These hardware capabilities accelerate cryptographic operations via AES and SHA_NI, as well as vector and matrix mathematics. The processor features a large 260 MB L3 cache, alongside 2 MB of L2 cache and 48 KB of L1d cache per core, facilitating efficient data access for localized workloads.

Benchmark results indicate strong single-core performance, with a Geekbench single-core score of 2228.0 and high throughput in single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression. However, multi-core scaling and memory bandwidth represent notable tradeoffs. The instance registers weaker performance in multi-core stress-ng tests, software compilation with Clang, and uncached memory bandwidth write operations, which peak at 20.39 GB/sec. Database operations, static web serving, and small-model LLM inference process at average tiers.

Given its compute-focused allocation and lower memory-to-CPU ratio, this instance offers a specialized hardware profile for workloads that prioritize raw single-threaded CPU speed over massive memory footprints. It is well-suited for single-threaded processing tasks, lightweight web serving, text processing, and basic vector math operations. It is less optimal for memory-intensive databases or highly parallelized compilation tasks due to its memory bandwidth and multi-core scaling limitations.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highcpu-4 is a compute-optimized instance featuring 4 vCPUs and 8.0 GB of RAM, powered by an Intel Xeon 8581C processor. Operating on the x86_64 architecture, it provides 2 physical cores with hyper-threading and a 260 MB L3 cache. The hardware supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel AMX for matrix operations. While the instance demonstrates strong single-threaded performance in compression and text processing benchmarks, it exhibits lower relative performance in memory bandwidth and multi-core scaling tests. Lacking local storage and GPUs, this instance is designed for compute-bound workloads that do not require large memory allocations. It is best suited for lightweight web serving, text processing, and single-threaded execution tasks where high single-core efficiency is required.
